titlePlain: Error Handling and Idempotency in Security

eyebrow: Treat failure as the normal case

steps.label: Backoff if retryable
steps.sub: exponential wait plus jitter, never an instant retry

steps.label: Reuse one idempotency key
steps.sub: so a retried side effect never double-executes

caption: Only retryable failures get backed off; a permanent error or the final attempt re-raises immediately.

code:
key = idempotency_key or str(uuid.uuid4())  # generated ONCE, outside the loop
resp = requests.post(
    FIREWALL_URL, json={"ip": ip_address},
    headers={"Idempotency-Key": key, "Authorization": AUTH},
    timeout=10,
)
caption: The same key must be reused on every retry of this call, or it stops protecting against a duplicate block.

subtitle: Webhooks, tickets, and ChatOps now share one defensive scripting pattern.
